motion_rule: EVERY second something large crosses or fills the frame: her, the coin, a dust plume or the camera; never a second where only the mouth moves; shot size keeps changing wide to macro
character: a plush grey chinchilla, enormous black eyes, huge ears, absurdly thick fur, a tiny gold crown from the first frame, smug and serious
props: ONE wide shallow bowl of grey volcanic ash on the floor, nothing stacked; ONE thick gold coin bigger than her head, smooth, no numbers; her crown; furry-windshield mic in the bottom right corner, never touched
prop_continuity: coin on the floor 0.0-2.3, in her paws 2.3-6.5, in the bowl from 6.5; crown on her head to 9.3, in the bowl after
environment: a sunlit wooden floor by a tall window, one bowl on it, nothing else in reach
lighting: bright midday daylight through the window, hard sun on the floor, crisp shadows, high exposure, plumes backlit so they glow
dust_bursts: a plume bursts over the lens and clears at 0.0, 4.6, 7.2, 8.5; each fills the frame
camera_moves: wide at 0.0, pushes to macro of her eye by 6.5, snaps back wide at 9.7; moves on 2.3, 4.6, 7.2 only

audio.language: Russian, lines verbatim; latin hints never spoken
audio.delivery: bright smug female voice, even 4.3 syllables/sec
audio.pronunciation: SHORST-ka stress the first syllable, PREH-mee-oom pod-PEE-sok
audio.pacing: the 3.0, 4.6 and 5.75 lines run together with no breath; one pause only, 2.3-3.0; voiceless after 7.2, sfx keep going
audio.lip_sync: mouth opens and closes clearly on every syllable, never a voice over

timeline.a: silent. A plume of grey ash bursts out of the bowl straight over the lens and clears
silent. She erupts out of the bowl in a full backflip filling the frame, lands upright beside it
she rears to full height until her chest fills the frame, ash sheeting off her fur in one curtain
silent. She hauls the huge coin up and slams it flat against the lens, blacking out the frame
silent. The coin drops away and she is suddenly small and far off across the wide floor
she drags the coin edge-on across the whole floor to the bowl, sweeping the frame left to right
same sentence, no breath. She heaves the coin over her head into the bowl, ash bursts over the lens
same sentence, no breath. She walks straight at the lens until her head fills the frame
macro on one enormous eye and the crown above it, dead still, staring into the lens
silent from now on. She throws herself backwards into the bowl, a plume twice the size over the lens
silent. The frame is solid glowing ash; her tail whips past the lens and is gone
silent. She rises out of the ash and shakes once, hard, blowing a ring of dust past the lens
silent. She lifts the crown off her own head and drops it in the bowl without a thought
silent. Camera snaps wide: one bowl on the bare floor, a smug chinchilla in it, ash settling

must_appear: the bowl stands on the floor with nothing stacked, the coin is bigger than her head, the crown goes in at 9.3, plumes cover the lens at 0.0, 4.6, 7.2, 8.5
negative_prompt: night, dusk, dark scene, moody lighting, low key, lamplight, bowls stacked, a podium or tower of bowls, floating props, a second bowl, a second coin, a second crown, a second chinchilla, glitter, confetti, people, hands, other animals, smiling, laughing, slow motion, speed ramp, any voice from her after 7.2, silence in the tail, accented Russian, drawn-out delivery, stretched vowels, swallowed endings, lettering, numbers, subtitles, watermark, English speech, grain, fog, sepia
